description.en:
PsiBot V1 is an embodied-robot platform with articulated manipulation and a sensor arrangement intended to observe its surrounding workspace. PsiBot's product specification lists four RGB-D cameras, three fisheye cameras and a Thor computing platform, alongside two-degree-of-freedom waist and neck assemblies.

The manufacturer states a standing height below 1.80 metres, a single-arm reach of 683 mm and battery life exceeding eight hours. Cable charging and automatic return charging are listed options. These figures are manufacturer specifications; the published page does not establish task-specific payload or performance under a common independent test.
